lines.text: [VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Huh? You look pretty pleased\nabout something, [VAR TRNAME(0000)].\c\n...Oh, you beat another Trainer? Good job!
Well, since we’re on the topic...\c\nThe Pokémon you sent into battle might’ve lost\nsome HP or PP...

You should take ’em to a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Pokémon Center [VAR COLOR(0000)]and
get them healed up!\c
It doesn’t cost any money and doesn’t take long
at all, either.
